      const q=cl(t/.72-i*.09); if(q<=.01) continue;

   }
   if(t>.5){

        const a=i*Math.PI/2+elapsed*.005;
        done=art(ctx,'snowflake',0,bx+Math.cos(a)*(8+imp*15),by+Math.sin(a)*(6+imp*10),22+imp*14,22+imp*14,a,fade*(.8-i*.12))||done;
      }
   }
   if(t>.28&&t<.78&&e)e.shake=Math.max(e.shake||0,2.2);

      }
   }

 } else if(key==='ceutempestuoso'){
   if(t<.92){
      done=art(ctx,'storm_cloud',0,bx-18,by-20,84,34,0,fade*.68)||done;
      done=art(ctx,'storm_cloud',0,bx+18,by-16,70,28,0,fade*.56)||done;

   }

}

// V35.76 · refino visual: Psybeam / Tempestade de Neve / Fúria Ancestral / Céu Tempestuoso.
(function(){
'use strict';
const SPRITES={"rock":"data:image/png;base64,","hail":"data:image/png;base64,","snowflake":"data:image/png;base64,","ring":"data:image/png;base64,","orb":"data:image/png;base64,","tornado":"data:image/png;base64,"};
const TARGETS=new Set(['psybeam','tempestadedeneve','furiaancestral','ceutempestuoso']);
const images={};
for(const k in SPRITES){ const im=new Image(); im.src=SPRITES[k]; images[k]=im; }
const counts={psybeam:0,tempestadedeneve:0,furiaancestral:0,ceutempestuoso:0};
const norm=s=>String(s||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
const clamp=v=>Math.max(0,Math.min(1,v));
const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
const prevPainter=window.PokemonTorreV360Paint;
function drawPath(ctx,pts,width,color,alphaMul){
  if(!pts || pts.length<2) return;
  ctx.save(); ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.lineJoin='round';
  ctx.strokeStyle=color.replace('ALPHA', String((alphaMul||1)*0.18)); ctx.lineWidth=width*2.4;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]); for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]); ctx.stroke();

  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]); for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

function glow(ctx,x,y,r,inner,outer,a){

}
function sprite(ctx,key,x,y,w,h,opt){
  opt=opt||{}; const img=images[key]; if(!img||!img.complete||img.naturalWidth<1) return false;
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.rotate(opt.rot||0); ctx.globalAlpha=opt.alpha==null?1:opt.alpha; ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
  ctx.drawImage(img,-w/2,-h/2,w,h); ctx.restore(); return true;
}
function impactRing(ctx,x,y,r,color,a){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle=color.replace('ALPHA', String(a)); ctx.lineWidth=2.2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x,y,r,r*0.72,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle=color.replace('ALPHA', String(a*0.25)); ctx.lineWidth=6;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x,y,r,r*0.72,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}
function sparkLine(ctx,x1,y1,x2,y2,segments,amp,color,a){
  const dx=x2-x1, dy=y2-y1, len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1, nx=-dy/len, ny=dx/len;
  const pts=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=segments;i++){
    const t=i/segments;
    const wave=(i===0||i===segments)?0:((i%2===0?1:-1)*amp*(0.6+0.12*(i%3)));
    pts.push([lerp(x1,x2,t)+nx*wave, lerp(y1,y2,t)+ny*wave]);
  }
  drawPath(ctx,pts,2,color,a);
}

function drawPsybeam(ctx,fx,now,state){
  const elapsed=Math.max(0,now-fx.at), dur=Math.max(880,fx.duration||880), t=clamp(elapsed/dur);
  const from=fx.from||[0,0], to=fx.to||[0,0];
  const ax=from[0], ay=from[1], bx=to[0], by=to[1];
  const dx=bx-ax, dy=by-ay, len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1, nx=-dy/len, ny=dx/len;
  const prog=clamp(t/0.82);
  const pts=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=20;i++){
    const q=(i/20)*prog;
    const wave=Math.sin(q*15-elapsed*0.016)*10 + Math.sin(q*7+elapsed*0.011)*4;
    const x=lerp(ax,bx,q)+nx*wave, y=lerp(ay,by,q)+ny*wave;
    pts.push([x,y]);
    glow(ctx,x,y,9+7*q,'rgba(255,225,255,ALPHA)','rgba(162,55,255,ALPHA)',0.2+0.5*q);
    if(i%4===0) sprite(ctx,'ring',x,y,16+8*q,12+6*q,{rot:q*10+elapsed*0.002,alpha:0.72});
    if(i%5===2) sprite(ctx,'orb',x+Math.cos(i+elapsed*0.01)*2,y+Math.sin(i+elapsed*0.01)*2,11+6*q,11+6*q,{alpha:0.9});
  }
  drawPath(ctx,pts,4,'rgba(255,170,255,ALPHA)',0.92);
  drawPath(ctx,pts,2,'rgba(170,80,255,ALPHA)',0.96);
  if(t>0.46){
    const p=clamp((t-0.46)/0.32);
    glow(ctx,bx,by,26+26*p,'rgba(255,255,255,ALPHA)','rgba(200,90,255,ALPHA)',0.8*(1-p*0.1));
    impactRing(ctx,bx,by,10+24*p,'rgba(238,190,255,ALPHA)',0.86*(1-p*0.12));
    sprite(ctx,'ring',bx,by,22+24*p,18+18*p,{rot:elapsed*0.006,alpha:0.75*(1-p*0.1)});
  }
  if(state && t>0.12 && t<0.8) state.shake=Math.max(state.shake||0,2.1);
  counts.psybeam++; return true;
}

function drawBlizzard(ctx,fx,now,state){
  const elapsed=Math.max(0,now-fx.at), dur=Math.max(960,fx.duration||960), t=clamp(elapsed/dur);
  const to=fx.to||[0,0], bx=to[0], by=to[1];
  glow(ctx,bx,by,34,'rgba(235,245,255,ALPHA)','rgba(110,185,255,ALPHA)',0.26+0.1*Math.sin(elapsed*0.012));
  for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
    const ang=i*2.399 + elapsed*0.012 + t*5.5;
    const radius=8 + ((i*11+elapsed*0.06)%34);
    const x=bx+Math.cos(ang)*radius, y=by+Math.sin(ang)*radius*0.65;
    if(i%3===0) sprite(ctx,'snowflake',x,y,14,14,{rot:ang,alpha:0.78});

  }
  for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
    const fall=((elapsed*0.32 + i*13) % 110) - 55;
    const drift=Math.sin(i*2 + elapsed*0.008)*8;
    const x=bx-36+(i%6)*14+drift, y=by-55+fall;
    ctx.save(); ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(230,245,255,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth=1.4;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y); ctx.lineTo(x-2.5,y+8); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore();

  if(t>0.52){

  }

}

function drawAncientPower(ctx,fx,now,state){
  const elapsed=Math.max(0,now-fx.at), dur=Math.max(980,fx.duration||980), t=clamp(elapsed/dur);
  const from=fx.from||[0,0], to=fx.to||[0,0];
  const ax=from[0], ay=from[1], bx=to[0], by=to[1];
  glow(ctx,ax,ay+8,18,'rgba(255,220,150,ALPHA)','rgba(165,100,45,ALPHA)',0.22);

      size=11+i*1.8; rot=base; alpha=0.85;
      glow(ctx,x,y,8,'rgba(255,220,150,ALPHA)','rgba(150,90,40,ALPHA)',0.18);

      const q=clamp((t-0.42)/0.34);
      const sx=ax+Math.cos(base)*18, sy=ay-8+Math.sin(base)*10;
      x=lerp(sx,bx,q)+Math.sin(q*8+i)*4;
      y=lerp(sy,by,q)-Math.sin(q*Math.PI)*16;
      size=14+i*1.4; rot=base+q*3.5; alpha=0.92;

      const x=bx+Math.cos(ang)*(8+18*p), y=by+Math.sin(ang)*(6+12*p);

  if(state && t>0.28 && t<0.9) state.shake=Math.max(state.shake||0,3.2);
  counts.furiaancestral++; return true;
}

function drawStormSky(ctx,fx,now,state){
  const elapsed=Math.max(0,now-fx.at), dur=Math.max(940,fx.duration||940), t=clamp(elapsed/dur);
  const from=fx.from||[0,0], to=fx.to||[0,0];

}

window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,state){

(function(){

function strokePath(ctx,pts,w,col,a){ if(!pts||pts.length<2) return; ctx.save(); ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.lineJoin='round'; ctx.strokeStyle=col.replace('ALPHA',String((a||1)*0.22)); ctx.lineWidth=w*2.2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]); for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]); ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle=col.replace('ALPHA',String(a||1)); ctx.lineWidth=w; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]); for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0],pts[i][1]); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore(); }

<style>
#ptWebSave{position:fixed;right:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:2147483640;background:#12283a;color:#d7fff2;border:1px solid #59c1ab;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 11px;font:600 13px system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 3px 14px #0007}
#ptWebPanel{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483641;background:#020912ce;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px}
#ptWebPanel .inside{background:#163044;color:#e5faf9;max-width:430px;width:100%;padding:20px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid #5a9eac;font:15px system-ui}
#ptWebPanel button,#ptWebPanel label{background:#28465a;color:white;border:1px solid #88c6cd;padding:10px 13px;border-radius:8px;margin:4px;display:inline-block}
</style>
<button id="ptWebSave" type="button">☁️ Salvar / Migrar</button>
<div id="ptWebPanel"><div class="inside"><h3>Pokémon Torre — progresso</h3>
<p>Para mudar do arquivo baixado para o site, abra o arquivo antigo, exporte o progresso, depois abra o site e importe. Nada é apagado antes da confirmação.</p>
<button id="ptExport" type="button">⬇️ Exportar progresso</button>
<label>⬆️ Importar progresso <input type="file" id="ptImport" accept=".json,application/json" style="display:none"></label>
<button id="ptClose" type="button">Fechar</button><p id="ptMessage" aria-live="polite"></p>
</div></div>
<script>
(()=>{'use strict';
const key='pokeTorreKantoV14';
const panel=document.getElementById('ptWebPanel');
document.getElementById('ptWebSave').onclick=()=>panel.style.display='flex';
document.getElementById('ptClose').onclick=()=>panel.style.display='none';
const msg=s=>document.getElementById('ptMessage').textContent=s;
document.getElementById('ptExport').onclick=()=>{
 try{
 const raw=localStorage.getItem(key);
 if(!raw)throw Error('Não existe progresso salvo neste navegador.');
 const save=JSON.parse(raw);
 if(!save||!Array.isArray(save.team))throw Error('Salvamento inválido.');
 const data={format:'PokemonTorreSave',version:1,date:new Date().toISOString(),storageKey:key,save};
 const b=new Blob([JSON.stringify(data)],{type:'application/json'});
 const u=URL.createObjectURL(b),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download='pokemon-torre-progresso.json';a.click();
 setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),2000);
 msg('Arquivo de progresso exportado.');
 }catch(e){msg(e.message)}
};
document.getElementById('ptImport').onchange=async ev=>{
 try{
 const file=ev.target.files[0];if(!file)return;
 const obj=JSON.parse(await file.text()),s=obj.save;
 if(obj.format!=='PokemonTorreSave'||!s||!Array.isArray(s.team)||s.team.length>6||!Number.isInteger(s.gym)||s.gym<0||s.gym>13)throw Error('Arquivo de progresso inválido.');
 if(!confirm('Importar o progresso substituirá o salvamento atual deste navegador. Continuar?'))return;
 const old=localStorage.getItem(key);
 if(old)localStorage.setItem(key+'__antes_de_importar',old);
 localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(s));location.reload();
 }catch(e){msg(e.message)}
};
})();
</script>

</body></html>
